title: Guardrails and Governance for Generative AI
description: Generative AI guardrails are the first line of defense, acting as a set of rules and limitations to keep AI outputs aligned with ethical principles.LLM guardrails are a specialized subset of generative AI guardrails specifically designed for the unique challenges of large language models.Governance controls establish the overarching principles and goals that guide the development and use of AI. They encompass guardrails but extend beyond them.
